fact: The Ministry of Justice reported on 6 December 2023 that its statistical yearbook and key-indicator analysis for 2022, drawn from courts, prisons and justice houses, were validated on 4 December 2023.
title: Atelier de validation de l'annuaire statistique et du document d'analyse des indicateurs clés 2022 du secteur de la justice
publisher: Ministère de la Justice et des Droits Humains
